annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost (RepairPal)

maint.job: Oil and filter change (gas or diesel)
maint.every: Every 3,000–5,000 miles (gas) or 5,000 miles (diesel); sooner when towing
maint.note: The 7.3L and 6.0L diesels hold about 15 quarts of diesel-rated oil, so their oil changes cost more.
This heavy SUV is hard on brakes, especially when towing.
Diesel models use two batteries; replace them as a pair. Weak batteries are hard on the 6.0L's injector module.
Diesels have glow plugs instead. On the 5.4L and 6.8L, the plugs must be torqued correctly to avoid blowouts.

maint.every: About every 5 years or 100,000 miles; check diesel coolant condition more often
maint.note: Clean coolant matters a lot on the 6.0L diesel, whose oil cooler clogs with debris.
